versions.content: If an API PduR_SomeIpTpCopyTxData()returns some- thing else than BUFREQ_OK, • The disassembly process for this PDU ID shall be canceled. • The API PduR_SomeIpTpTxConfirmation()with result set to E_NOT_OK shall be called. • The API Det_ReportRuntimeError() shall be called with the runtime error code SOMEIPTP_E_DISASSEMBLY_INTERRUPT.

snippets.why: disassembly interruption on copy tx error
